facts.value: If your programme begins in Autumn or Spring, an online induction will be run by your faculty. Induction takes place during the 10 day-window before your programme begins.
Induction will provide you with all the information you need to start your programme.
A timetable will be created and you'll learn more about what to expect each semester.
At this point you will also gain access to UL's Virtual Learning Environment (VLE) which is called Brightspace.
You are encouraged to log into Brightspace in particular to familiarise yourself with the platform and wealth of supports associated with using it.
For many Autumn programmes, an on-campus orientation will take place on the Friday before week 1 of the semester.
myUL is UL’s app for students, helping you stay informed, supported and connected on campus.
The app includes your timetable, an interactive campus map, Clubs & Societies, access to key student supports - all in one place.
Details on how to download and log into the myUL app are available at myUL App.

The Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (AHSS) is a dynamic community where ideas are explored, challenged, and brought to life. It offers high-quality teaching and a rich research environment that spans traditional disciplines and innovative interdisciplinary work.

The Education and Health Sciences (EHS) Faculty includes the Schools of Medicine, Allied Health, Education, and Nursing and Midwifery as well as the Departments of Psychology, Physical Education and Sport Sciences. The faculty has built a reputation for high-quality teaching and innovative academic programmes. It works hard to prepare excellent scientists and caring, competent health professionals.
